e2e.environment: dedicated resident audit Chrome via CDP 9333 (persistent profile, reused across runs); chrome-ensure reuse; one tab opened and closed; no temp Chrome/profile

modeLabel: 2–10 人 · 联机 + AI 补位 / 3–5 人单人 AI

online.transport: HTTP/JSON + 700ms polling; server-authoritative; LAN-only by default

features.rooms: 2–10 seats; room id + invite token + optional password
features.invite: inviteUrl uses the request Host; opens /boardgame/six-nimmt-premium/online.html?room=&code=
features.stateSync: stateVersion + lastAction; every viewer receives the same public view
features.simultaneousPicks: each human submits one hidden card; opponents only see picked:true, never the card; AI seats fill server-side
features.aiFill: empty seats fill to 3 players (up to 10) with the same engine and pure AI decision function
features.reconnect: session token + POST /api/rooms/:id/reconnect; reconnect clears timeout takeover
features.timeoutTakeover: no session request for 15s → server AI plays the seat; reconnect restores it
features.leaderboard: GET /api/leaderboard?game=six-nimmt-premium; AI participants included; raw playerId hashed
features.idempotency: per-player idempotencyKey cached before the action guard

evidence.runAll: test-online.js is auto-discovered by node games/tests/run-all.js

shared.shuffle: games/shared/shuffle.js — engine.js require + index.html script tag; seeded Fisher-Yates
shared.sfx: games/shared/sfx.js — index.html script tag; no per-game AudioContext
shared.rules: N/A — 6 Nimmt rules live in engine.js
shared.leaderboard: shared room server keeps an anonymous in-memory board; no leaderboard copy

rules.bullHeads: 55=7; multiples of 11=5; multiples of 10=3; multiples of 5=2; else 1
rules.resolution: simultaneous picks, ascending reveal; highest lower row end; below all rows = choose a row; sixth card takes five
rules.scoring: sum bull heads of taken cards; lowest total wins; ties share the win
